# zh-2000 (synthetic test song)

Generated by KaraForge's own benchmark generator (`kfbench.synth`, language `zh`, seed 2000,
vocal-to-accompaniment ratio 10 dB) and encoded to MP3 for the integration tests.

- Lyrics: original text from `bench/kfbench/synth/corpus.py` (Apache-2.0).
- Voice: Kokoro-82M text-to-speech (Apache-2.0 model and voices), re-pitched and stretched
  with the WORLD vocoder.
- Accompaniment: synthesised with numpy.
- `truth.json`: the exact start and end of every token, known from construction.

Nothing here is a real recording; the files may be redistributed under the project licence.
